card.name: Banking text: numbers and linking words
card.fires_on: Spaces, digits and small linking words in passages about banks, deposited money and coins or banknotes. Often the space before a year or number, or the digit 8 in a 1980s-style year.

modes.label: Space before a year or number
modes.description: The space just before a date or count in a history of banking.

modes.label: Linking words about deposits
modes.description: Small words such as been, the or by in sentences about money banks hold for customers.
modes.example: Banks claim ownership of the cash that has<< been>> deposited by their customers.

modes.description: The digit 8 inside a 1980s year in text about money or coins.
